title: GCP Essentials
summary: Google Cloud Platform from the ground up — resource hierarchy and IAM, compute (GCE/GKE/Cloud Run), networking, storage, the database lineup (Spanner, AlloyDB, Bigtable, Firestore), BigQuery analytics, security and KMS, observability, Vertex AI, pricing and quotas, and the 2026 frontier.

volatileChapters.reason: Vertex AI ships features quarterly; Gemini model lineup evolves; AI Agent Builder + Vector Search churn rapidly with the AI race.
GCP pricing changes (egress, network egress, AI inference) move per quarter; commit / sustained-use discount programs evolve.
New 2026 services and GA promotions happen every Google Cloud Next; deprecations are continuous.

inspiredBy.title: Google Cloud documentation + GCP Architecture Framework

chapters.title: Resource Hierarchy and IAM
chapters.summary: GCP's foundational identity model — organization, folders, projects; IAM principals, roles (primitive/predefined/custom), policy bindings, IAM conditions; Workload Identity Federation; service accounts and audit logging.

chapters.title: Compute
chapters.summary: GCE and the VM landscape — machine families (N/C/M/A), custom machine types, instance templates, managed instance groups (MIGs), sole-tenant nodes, spot VMs, sustained-use and committed-use discounts, live migration, Shielded VMs.

chapters.title: Containers on GCP
chapters.summary: GKE and Anthos — GKE Standard vs Autopilot, node pools, Artifact Registry, Cloud Build, multi-cluster ingress, Workload Identity, Binary Authorization, Config Sync, GKE Enterprise, and the deprecated Container Registry transition.

chapters.title: Serverless Compute
chapters.summary: Cloud Run and friends — Cloud Run services and jobs, Cloud Functions 2nd gen, App Engine (legacy context), cold starts, concurrency settings, CPU allocation modes, Cloud Scheduler, Cloud Tasks, Eventarc, and Cloud Workflows.

chapters.title: Networking
chapters.summary: VPC and connectivity — global vs regional VPC, subnets, firewall rules, Cloud Load Balancing tiers, Cloud CDN, Cloud Armor, VPC Service Controls, Private Service Connect, Cloud NAT, Cloud Interconnect / VPN, Network Endpoint Groups.

chapters.title: Storage
chapters.summary: Object and block — Cloud Storage classes (Standard/Nearline/Coldline/Archive), object lifecycle, Cloud Storage FUSE, Filestore (NFS), Persistent Disk tiers, Hyperdisk, signed URLs, retention policies, and CMEK encryption.

chapters.title: Databases
chapters.summary: The GCP database lineup — Cloud SQL, AlloyDB, Spanner (with TrueTime), Bigtable, Firestore, Memorystore; database choice flows; Datastream CDC; Database Migration Service; backup and PITR; Spanner schema design (interleaved tables).

chapters.title: Data Analytics
chapters.summary: The BigQuery-centered analytics stack — BigQuery storage (capacitor) and compute (slots), BigQuery ML, BigQuery Omni, Dataflow (Beam), Pub/Sub (and Lite), Dataproc, Composer (Airflow), Looker, Analytics Hub, Dataplex, BigLake.

chapters.title: Identity, Security, KMS
chapters.summary: Encryption + zero trust — Cloud KMS, CMEK, CSEK, Secret Manager, Binary Authorization, Confidential VMs and GKE Nodes, Cloud HSM, Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP), BeyondCorp Enterprise, Cloud Identity, reCAPTCHA Enterprise, Security Command Center.

chapters.title: Observability on GCP
chapters.summary: Cloud Operations Suite — Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Trace, Cloud Profiler, Error Reporting; SLO objects, Log Router and sinks, log-based metrics, uptime checks, alerting policies, Anthos Service Mesh telemetry, and OpenTelemetry on GCP.

chapters.title: AI on GCP
chapters.summary: The Vertex AI platform — Model Garden (Gemini, Llama, Mistral), Gemini APIs (Pro/Flash/Nano), Vertex AI Workbench, Pipelines, AutoML, Vertex AI Search (RAG-as-a-service), Embeddings APIs, Vector Search, AI Agent Builder, Document AI, and Imagen/Veo.

chapters.title: Pricing and Quotas
chapters.summary: The FinOps surface — egress pricing (the silent budget killer), per-service quotas and increase requests, committed-use and sustained-use discounts, the free tier, billing exports to BigQuery, budget alerts, Active Assist cost recommendations, Cloud Billing labels.

chapters.title: The GCP Frontier
chapters.summary: What's new in 2026 — Cross-Cloud Network, Cloud Run worker pools, Spanner Graph, Vertex AI agent platform, expanded Confidential Computing, carbon footprint reporting, SaaS Runtime, Google Distributed Cloud (air-gapped), GKE Multi-Cloud, and the Gemini-native cloud direction.
